title: Dispute
description: A card payment dispute (chargeback) initiated by a cardholder through their card issuer. Disputes require evidence submission or acceptance.

transferID.description: The transfer associated with this dispute.

phase.description: Current phase of the dispute lifecycle.

reason.description: Card network reason code for the dispute.

networkReasonCode.description: Specific reason code from the card network.

respondBy.description: ISO 8601 deadline for submitting evidence to contest the dispute.

createdOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the dispute was created.

updatedOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the dispute was last updated.
